Introduction

NAZE is a seven-member pre-debut boy group under C9 Entertainment. They are set to debut in the second half of 2025. First announced on April 26, 2024, the members starred in the TBS Japanese drama "DREAM STAGE", which started airing on August 8, 2025. After launching SNS accounts as “C9ROOKIES” on June 17, 2025, the group revealed its members—Dohyeok, Kimkun, Younki, Turn, Ato, Yuya, and Kaisei—between June 19 and 25. The official group name, NAZE, was announced on August 5.
